abilities.name: Intercessor Focus
abilities.text: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to any Ballistic Skill (A) Tests to fire a ranged weapon with the PRIMARIS Keyword. The Bolt Rifle and Heavy Bolt Pistol qualify (Core p.217); his Deathwatch weapons do not.

abilities.name: Heavy Intercessor Doctrine
abilities.text: You receive Mark X Gravis armour if you don't already have it and one of the following weapons: Heavy Bolt Rifle, Heavy Bolter. You additional +Rank AP when using this weapon. Furthermore, you gain the Bolter Discipline Talent (see page 45). He chose the Heavy Bolter, which the Deathwatch armoury swapped out, so the +Rank AP applies to none of his weapons.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you ignore any impurities in your Chapter Gene-Seed, and also gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Fury Within
abilities.text: You are possessed of a bloodthirsty recklessness. When properly directed, this murderous ferocity makes you unstoppable. You may re-roll Double Rank dice once per melee attack Test. In addition, if you shift one or more Icons on a melee attack, improve the AP of your attack by 1 (i.e., from -1 to -2).

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Courage (+1 Resolve); Accomplishment Crusader (+1 Determination); Goal Vengeance (+1 Determination). Determination is 8 (T 6 + 2).

talents.name: Bolter Discipline
talents.text: When you use a weapon with the BOLT Keyword, it gains the Rapid Fire (2) Trait. If the weapon already has the Rapid Fire Trait, add +Rank to the weapon's Rapid Fire rating.

talents.name: Fearless
talents.text: You automatically pass any Fear Test. You are immune to Intimidation (Wil) Interaction Attacks.

gear: Spare armour: Mk X Tacticus (AR 5, Powered (4)); only one suit's AR counts at a time (Core p.231)
Ballistic Appeasement Auto-Reliquary (Core p.236): clear a jammed weapon as a Free Action
Kraken Bolt rounds (AP −2, Core p.231; BOLT weapons only)

detail.personality: His Chapter was nearly wiped out and rebuilt. He rations ammunition like bread and laughs only when the odds are hopeless, which is when the frag cannon speaks. He knows the Red Thirst from the inside, and he watches Sarrius the way a man watches his own reflection.

objectives.text: Chapter: let no Ork escape the site.
